mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_SESSIONS ( session_id, user_id, title, region_level1, region_level2, age, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{regionLevel1}, #{regionLevel2, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{age, jdbcType=INTEGER}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, user_id, title, region_level1, region_level2, age, created_at, updated_at FROM CHAT_SESSIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT session_id, user_id, title, region_level1, region_level2, age, created_at, updated_at FROM CHAT_SESSIONS WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_SESSIONS SET title = #{title}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
